extracted.intended_audience: applicants and attorneys filing trademark Responses to Office Actions via the USPTO TEAS system
extracted.subtask_description: Filling and submitting the USPTO TEAS Response to Office Action form (PTO Form 1957) to address refusals/requirements in a trademark application, including arguments, evidence, amendments, and required declarations. Applies to applicants, owners, and attorneys interacting with the TEAS wizard and validation/payment workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: 60-minute time limit
rubrics_metrics.description: This form "times-out" 60 minutes after accessing this page unless you extend the time limit when the time-out warning appears on screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Have all information ready before starting; extend time when warned. Failure to do so may lose entered data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use only form navigation
rubrics_metrics.description: DO NOT USE YOUR BROWSER BACK/FORWARD BUTTONS: Use only the navigation buttons at the bottom of each page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Using browser navigation may break the form session or lose data.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required fields must be completed
rubrics_metrics.description: REQUIRED FIELDS: All have an ASTERISK (*), and the form will not validate if these fields are not filled-out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form validation will prevent submission until mandatory fields are provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check application status before use
rubrics_metrics.description: To use this form, the "Current Status" of your application must be "A Non-final Action has been mailed."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the application is not in the correct status, wait until status updates (usually 48-72 hours after notice) or you'll receive an error when continuing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Signature requirements and options
rubrics_metrics.description: Sign the response form on the Signature Page. If the desired signatory is not available, options include electronic forwarding of the Signature Page, mailing/faxing a handwritten signature, or saving the form for later signature via Download Portable Data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A RESPONSE WITH ONLY YOUR SIGNATURE IS NOT ACCEPTABLE unless the only issue raised was that the original filing was unsigned, improperly signed, or lacked required declaration language.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validate and confirm before submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Validate the form by selecting the "Continue" button on the Signature Page and on the Validation Page confirm all information is displayed properly immediately before filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If previously-entered text or attachments are missing at validation, re-enter/re-attach before final submission or the USPTO will not receive those items.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment and submission sequence
rubrics_metrics.description: Click on the Pay/Submit button at the bottom of the Validation Page. If a fee payment is required, choose payment method (credit card, deposit account, or electronic funds transfer). Successful transmission yields a SUCCESS! Page and an e-mail acknowledgment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete payment screens when prompted; do not click Pay/Submit unless fully prepared. Credit card payments unavailable 2 a.m.–6 a.m. Sunday EST; if in that period, use deposit account, EFT, or save the form for later submission. Payment is a processing fee and is not refundable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic acknowledgment requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: ONCE A RESPONSE IS SUBMITTED ELECTRONICALLY, THE USPTO WILL IMMEDIATELY PROVIDE THE SENDER WITH AN ELECTRONIC ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF RECEIPT OF THE RESPONSE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact teas@uspto.gov within 24 hours if you do not receive the acknowledgment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Answer all wizard questions and respond to issues
rubrics_metrics.description: You must answer all wizard questions. At least one answer must be "Yes" or your response will be completely blank. Review the Office action and answer "Yes" to any question that directly relates to a requirement and/or refusal raised.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You must respond explicitly to each refusal and/or requirement; if the examining attorney requires specific wording, enter that wording in the proper place. Do not submit only a signature or authorize the examiner to make unspecified changes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Do not rely on a signature-only response
rubrics_metrics.description: A RESPONSE WITH ONLY YOUR SIGNATURE IS NOT ACCEPTABLE. Merely providing a response with a signature and no other information ... is not a proper response to the Office action (except if the only issue raised was that the original filing was unsigned, improperly signed, or lacked the required declaration language).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit substantive replies and required wording/evidence must be included where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Responding to refusals (likelihood of confusion, descriptiveness, etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: If you need to respond to a refusal to register your mark (e.g., likely to cause confusion, merely descriptive, primarily merely a surname, geographically descriptive, deceptive, functional, protected symbol, multiple marks, not perceived as trademark), you must answer "Yes" to this question to submit your arguments and, if necessary, attach supporting evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To submit a "substitute specimen" to overcome a refusal, also answer "Yes" to #2. Attach evidence in the Evidence Section and describe what the evidence consists of.

rubrics_metrics.name: Modifying goods/services — clarify or limit only
rubrics_metrics.description: You may only modify the identification of goods/services/the nature of the collective membership organization to clarify or limit the goods/services; adding to or broadening the scope ... is not permitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To ADD a new class, use a separate question/section and pay required fees. Warnings emphasize you may NOT exceed the scope of your current identification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Class additions and fees
rubrics_metrics.description: To ADD a new class(es) answer "Yes" to #6. To pay the fee(s) for additional class(es), answer "Yes" to #7.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You cannot add goods/services or broaden identifications within this amendment; a new filing may be required. Enter number of classes and pay per-class fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing basis rules (Section 1(a), 1(b), 44(d), 44(e))
rubrics_metrics.description: Detailed statements of what each filing basis means and warnings: Section 1(a) use in commerce requires specimen showing use; Section 1(b) intent-to-use requires Allegation of Use form unless responding to a specimen issue; Section 44(d) and 44(e) (priority/foreign registration) require specified documentation and have database storage limits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not select contradictory bases (e.g., Section 1(a) and 1(b) for identical goods/services). If selecting certain bases, additional filings/fees may be required later.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specimen requirements and statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Specimen attachments allowed (JPG/PDF up to stated size). For substitute/new specimens or originally-unverified specimens, check the required specimen statement attesting that the specimen was/were in use in commerce at least as early as the filing date (or appropriate milestone).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to include the required specimen statement will render the substitute/new specimen unacceptable. Willful false statements have criminal penalties under 18 U.S.C. §1001.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence attachments — formats and limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Attach evidence files via the Evidence Section. Acceptable formats include JPG/PDF (size limits), and certain multimedia (.WAV, .WMV, .WMA, .MP3, .MPG, .AVI) with specified size limits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: WARNING: Do not submit your entire response as a PDF file. Each portion of the form serves a specific purpose for data processing reasons; failure will cause significant delays. PDFs may be attached for arguments only in Evidence Section; check specific per-field file size limits (statements in form note both 5 MB per JPG/PDF and elsewhere 30 MB per PDF — follow the linked complete requirements).

rubrics_metrics.name: Goods/services entry format
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not enter a Class or any other code in the goods/services field. Enter only the common commercial name for the specific goods/services. If entering multiple listings separate with a semicolon (;), NOT a comma.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the USPTO's online Goods and/or Services Manual for acceptable language. Improper entries or HTML/programming code will be rejected or create links.

rubrics_metrics.name: Warnings about fraudulent/inaccurate statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Statements made in filings to the USPTO must be accurate; inaccuracies could result in the cancellation of a trademark registration. Willful false statements are punishable by fine or imprisonment under 18 U.S.C. §1001.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples include lack of bona fide intention to use the mark on all goods/services claimed, or lack of use on goods/services for which use is claimed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Additional statements formatting and use
rubrics_metrics.description: Additional statements (disclaimers, colors claimed, description of mark, stippling, claim of prior registrations, translation/transliteration, Section 2(f) claim, consent, supplemental register amendment, concurrent use claim, miscellaneous statement) will display in the "Additional Statement(s)" section; include only words that are in the mark or translations/transliterations in quotation marks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not use this section for attachments where a specific section exists. Use the miscellaneous statement field to request deletion of a statement already of record. The Section 2(f) declaration will automatically appear where needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Concurrent use assertion requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: To assert concurrent use, you must (1) have a Section 1(a) filing basis (use in commerce), AND (2) either (i) intend to initiate a TTAB proceeding or have a Board determination establishing entitlement to concurrent registration, or (ii) have a final court determination establishing concurrent right to use in limited geographic area.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enter concurrent use information only in the specified textbox and ensure prerequisites are satisfied before asserting concurrent use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Mark amendment limitations (material change prohibition)
rubrics_metrics.description: While minor changes in the mark are sometimes permitted, any material alteration will NOT be permitted and will result in a refusal being issued on that ground.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If changing the drawing, JPG format required. Choose Standard Characters vs Special Form appropriately; after previewing USPTO image, use Special Form if you object to display.

rubrics_metrics.name: Standard character vs special form mark guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: To indicate standard characters (no claim to font/style/size/color) or Special Form (stylized/design) or Sound Mark. If object to USPTO-generated image, use Special Form to attach your own image and claim standard characters if desired.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Appropriateness of claiming standard characters will be determined during examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Owner information format and storage limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Owner name/street/city/state/etc. entries have character limits in the USPTO database (e.g., 40 characters for street, 22 characters for another field). If State/Country of incorporation actually changed, file an assignment form PTO-1594.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Abbreviate as necessary to avoid truncation and undeliverable addresses. Include geographical regions in city field separated by comma (e.g., Toronto, Ontario).

rubrics_metrics.name: Correspondence e-mail and authorization
rubrics_metrics.description: Only one e-mail address may be used for correspondence. Keep the address current; authorize the USPTO to communicate via e-mail by checking the box.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to maintain correct authorized e-mail for TEAS Plus/TEAS RF can cause loss of status and a processing fee ($50 per class). The applicant is solely responsible for receipt of USPTO e-mails.

rubrics_metrics.name: Miscellaneous statement and certification mark specifics
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the miscellaneous statement field only if no other section is appropriate; for collective marks based on Section 1(a), indicate method of control; for certification marks attach certification standards and state characteristics/standards to be certified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Suggested formats provided for method of control and for the certification statement. Attach files via the Miscellaneous Attachment control when necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declaration content and criminal warning
rubrics_metrics.description: The signatory declares that statements of own knowledge are true and statements on information and belief are believed true; willful false statements punishable under 18 U.S.C. §1001 and may jeopardize validity of application/registration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific additional declarations required depending on whether the application was unsigned and depending on which statutory filing basis was used (1(a),1(b),44, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Attorney signatory requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The signatory must confirm he/she is an attorney who is a member in good standing of the bar of the highest court of a U.S. state (including DC, Puerto Rico, federal territories), is currently the owner's/holder's attorney or an associate, and satisfy conditions relating to prior representatives and powers of attorney.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a newly appearing attorney is filing, answer YES only if the three underlying requirements are satisfied; failure may render the submission incomplete or not in compliance with minimum filing requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Form saving and reusing saved data
rubrics_metrics.description: You may download/save the Response via 'Download Portable Data.' To resume, open a new form, use 'Browse/Choose File' on the initial wizard page to import the saved file; you cannot open the saved .obj/.xml directly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You cannot change wizard answers when importing a saved form; to introduce a completely new section start a new form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Status-check timing after submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Do NOT attempt to check the status of a filing until at least 72 hours after submission to allow USPTO databases to update.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Checking earlier may not reflect the submission and could cause confusion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence description field required
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe what the evidence submitted consists of in the Evidence Section.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide clear descriptions to assist processing. File counts shown (e.g., '0 file(s) attached') and file names will appear in the Evidence Section summary.

rubrics_metrics.name: File type/size contradictions — follow linked complete requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Form contains multiple file size statements: e.g., 'JPG/PDF format (not exceeding 5 megabytes per attachment)' and elsewhere 'file size cannot exceed 5 megabytes per attachment for JPG or 30 megabytes per attachment for PDF.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the linked complete requirements on the USPTO site for authoritative file-size/format limits when in doubt (the form warns that complete requirements are linked).

rubrics_metrics.name: Public record and confidentiality warning
rubrics_metrics.description: All information submitted to the USPTO will become public record, including name, phone, e-mail, and street address. The filer acknowledges no right to confidentiality in the information disclosed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To maintain confidentiality of banking/credit card information, only enter payment information in the secure payment portion after validation. Copyrighted material submission represents granting USPTO permission to make information available publicly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment site and session warnings
rubrics_metrics.description: After clicking Pay/Submit you cannot return to the form; you will leave TEAS and enter a separate payment site; you must complete the Pay/Submit process within 30 minutes. Fee payments by credit card may be unavailable during specific hours.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If not ready to complete payment, use Download Portable Data to save the form and complete later, or Go Back to Modify to correct errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tracked text description and final description for amended goods/services
rubrics_metrics.description: When proposing amendments to class descriptions, tracked text and final description fields will be used to show changes and the Filing Basis must be indicated for each class.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure tracked changes accurately reflect the intended limitation/clarification and do not broaden scope; beware of storage/database limits and formatting constraints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of stippling/claim of colors and additional mark description rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Provided guidance on additional statements such as 'STIPPLING AS A FEATURE OF THE MARK', 'STIPPLING FOR SHADING', and 'No claim is made to the exclusive right to use ___ apart from the mark as shown.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include only words that are in the mark when providing such statements and use the correct field for the type of additional statement.
